answer: An AI-agent economy mitigates Sybil attacks using max-flow trust networks within a raven gossip layer. Validated agents assign scarce credit capacities to known peers, ensuring an attacker cannot forge edges or mirror legitimate routing paths to flood synthetic nodes. This forces adversaries to expend verifiable capital or human-mediated trust acquisition per identity. However, strict capacity bottlenecks penalize honest newcomers and entrench incumbent agent cartels.
